newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Banco Industrial 9-mo net profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Banco Industrial 9-mo net profit vs loss.

text.p: Mexico's Banco Industrial S.A. said on Thursday it posted a net profit of 3.33 million pesos in the first nine months of 1996, a dramatic improvement from a loss of 10.92 million pesos in the same period last year.
Operating profit in the first three quarters of this year were 21.91 million pesos, but the bank did not provide a comparison for the first three quarters of 1995.
Banco Industrial said that through September deposits were 2.777 billion pesos, up 86 percent versus the average in December 1995.
Loans totaled 2.063 billion pesos, down seven percent from December after taking inflation into account.
The bank said it would continue its capitalisation plan and would continue to look for foreign partners to that end.

"There have been significant advances for an association with a foreign financial entity, with Swiss and Spanish banks as options," Banco Industrial said, adding that a deal for bringing in a minority partner should be complete within 60 days.
